verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's autoscaling evidence is about Kubernetes Node Pool autoscaling (CKS) that scales nodes up/down with cluster demand, and Spot/On-Demand node pools for burst capacity — this is infrastructure-level autoscaling of always-managed clusters, not a serverless function/worker model where a developer deploys code and it scales to zero without managing nodes. No evidence describes a serverless deployment primitive (e.g., a CLI/API to push code and have it run as ephemeral, zero-idle-cost workers) akin to typical serverless GPU platforms.
